snaps.sub: Deadlines use the supplier country’s approved calendar — never a global Monday–Friday. Unverified holiday data blocks RFQ publication.

Deadline rule engine

  1. Confirm supplier country and its assigned calendar.
  2. Calendar includes public holidays and make-up workdays; yearly data verified by an administrator.
  3. Store UTC; show China time and Bangladesh time with zone name and offset.
  4. Closing = Nth eligible working day after the next working day following sending, at the configured hour.
  5. Reminder one supplier-country working day before close.
  6. At cut-off, revoke final submit server-side; keep submitted records.
  7. Extension needs a new date, reason and approver; the original deadline is kept.
  8. Calendar unavailable → block publication and alert Procurement.
